avis.titre: Hydrating, Firming & Perfect for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I recently started using Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream (Fragrance-Free), and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine! If you’re looking for a luxurious, effective moisturizer without any added scent, this one delivers on all fronts. 💧 Deep Hydration: This cream absorbs beautifully and keeps my skin feeling soft and moisturized all day — even in cooler or drier weather. It doesn’t sit heavy or greasy, but still locks in moisture. ✨ Improves Firmness & Texture: After consistent use, I’ve noticed my skin looks firmer and more lifted. Fine lines seem softer, and my overall complexion feels smoother and more resilient. 🌿 Fragrance-Free & Gentle: Since this version is fragrance-free, it’s perfect for sensitive skin or anyone who prefers minimal fragrance in their products. No irritation, no stinging — just soothing hydration. 🧴 Great Base for Makeup: This cream works wonderfully under makeup. It keeps skin smooth without pilling or interfering with foundation or concealer. 💆‍♀️ Rich Yet Lightweight: It’s rich enough to feel deeply nourishing but lightweight enough to wear day or night. I use it morning and evening — it’s that versatile. Overall, Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Cream (Fragrance-Free) is a fantastic moisturizer that hydrates, firms, and feels great on the skin. Highly recommend for anyone seeking effective, everyday anti-aging care! 🌟💧✨

I love that this cream helps target fine lines, wrinkles, and loss of elasticity while keeping my skin deeply hydrated. The Triple Collagen Peptides make my skin feel smoother, firmer, and more refreshed. Plus, it's fragrance-free perfect for everyday skincare

I don't think regenerist products or even retin A would work to erase wrinkles that are already there, but they would be good for keeping the skin healthy. avis.titre: I got a fake! The REAL cream is good though.
avis.texte: EDIT: I just realized that the jar I got from Amazon is a FAKE. Notice the crooked sticker on the jar. There are many other tell tale signs as well. I was reviewing the cream based on the experience I had with the first jar I used which was purchased at a physical store. I did purchase more from Amazon but only used it once. My review below is of the ACTUAL authentic cream. I suggest buying this product elsewhere or checking the jar carefully to be sure it is authentic.. I give the real cream 4 stars., I took a star off because I got a fake. ----- I used to use this cream but the overwhelming floral scent was too much for me so I switched to higher end stuff. When I saw that they had a fragrance free formula, I had to try it. I used one jar and bought a second here on Amazon. That one came in a huge box with a bonus package of 7 Olay Makeup Remover Pads. I wasn't expecting that but I'll take it! The cream is white and fairly thick with no scent at all. Ahhh, heaven! It smooths nicely on my face and absorbs almost immediately. I have really dry skin and usually like heavy creams but this one is great during the day before makeup or even under a thicker cream. Alone, it is still good but I just like to drench my skin in hydration. I just ordered the serum that goes with this cream and maybe the two will be enough. I immediately feel a firming of my face when I use this cream. I am in my mid 50's and holding up pretty well but gravity takes a toll and I am more worried about sag

avis.titre: My ‘must have’ day and night cream

People often tell me that my skin looks great. I am turning 57 this month; I am a mother of five, a grandmother, and spend plenty of time outdoors. I have tried other creams, serums, potions and lotions ( many costing 5 times more) and I always come back to Olay Regenerist. FYI- my Amazon profile pic was taken in 2008-2009. The photo here was 2021. I highly recommend!

It's been over a week and though they are deminishing, I still have burning rashes and my skin has started to peal like a sunburn. What in the heck is in this stuff? I suggest if anyone wants to try this stuff they do so in a very very very small amount (One dot max) to see if you break out.
